metadata.title: Don't Blame the Prompt.
metadata.note: Standalone teaching explainer (~90s) from creator's exact script. Narrator Muskan, @HumanitariansAI, banner 'Debugging Agents'. ONE insight: a hallucination is a PIPELINE bug, not just a prompt bug — trace each stage to the exact point of failure. The debugging loop: Reproduce → Trace → Retrieve → Inspect tools → Verify claims → Add an eval. Bookends render (composer/outro); body B01-B07 are house-style 4K PIL cards in media/ (B07 = the loop chain).

source_of_truth: beat_sheet.json — edit the sheet, not this file
